arguments.prompt: Use case illustration-story. Draw an actual TWO PANEL pencil grayscale staging storyboard for Neet & Buddy bazaar story. Panel A: low camera at spice stall, jars on sturdy low shelf. Small tan Neet has just sneezed and stands ONE STEP BACK staring suspiciously at jars, eyes narrowed, mouth settling, four fine paws grounded. Buddy stands behind Heather's lower legs at right peeking toward Neet, leash slack from his collar upward. Heather trousers and flat shoes only here. No airborne dramatic spice cloud. Panel B: wider market lane, a large calm cow walks to right and ignores the dogs; at left Heather (provisional adult woman wearing plain light shirt and trousers) holds Neet securely against chest with TWO arms, one under rump/hindquarters and one under chest. Both Neet hindlegs dangle naturally connected, forepaws folded over supporting arm. Neet regards retreating cow sternly, Buddy on four substantial legs beside Heather well clear of cow path. Shopping bag hangs at Heather elbow, Buddy leash in hand. Anatomically clear separate grounded feet and connected torsos. Real canine proportions as original photo inputs: N19/N29 tan Neet short SMOOTH fawn coat, full narrow torso fine legs, modest projecting muzzle, LARGE BROAD triangular ears, cream chest and muzzle, near-flush nub tail. B04/B29 Buddy moderately elongated charcoal torso, real neck/leg clearance, substantial limbs, pale muzzle moustache/brows, pendant ears, tan chest and distal legs, low slender tail. Body coats close smooth contours, NO curly fur, no engraving, no shaggy body edge. Pencil construction is for volumes and support, not fur. Input photos govern visible anatomy only; B29 stride not measurement; B04/B24 one exposure. No captions, lettering, speech balloons. Show complete construction and environment; no pose sheet. Warm affectionate comedy, no fear or confrontation.
